## Purpose
Bun install settings, including a 24-hour supply-chain guard on newly published package versions.

## Settings that matter
- `[install]`:
  - `saveTextLockfile = true`;
  - **`minimumReleaseAge = 86400`:** skip versions published less than a day ago;
  - **`minimumReleaseAgeExcludes`:** `@lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config`, `@lovable.dev/mcp-js`, `@lovable.dev/email-js`, `@lovable.dev/webhooks-js`.

## Read by
`bun install`, locally and in the Dockerfile.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
The file's comment says to confirm with the user before adding any package to the excludes.

## How to rebuild this file
Copy it as is.
